changes.archetype: Efficient early damage into poison and dexterity defense
changes.summary: Add efficient damage first, then poison scaling and dexterity-supported defense. Preserve gold and health; take elites when damage and potions support them. Upgrade core cards when healthy.

changes.archetype: Kunai shivs and dexterity defense with sustained poison
changes.summary: Use Footwork and Kunai to sustain defense while poison finishes long fights. Seek shiv generation and poison scaling, not more generic attacks. Smith while healthy; heal before the boss if depleted.

changes.archetype: Free attacks and draw fuel Kunai, Afterimage, and poison
changes.summary: Use free Strikes to trigger Kunai and Afterimage while reserving energy for defense and draw. Buy cycling and scaling at shops. Remove ordinary Defends, retain the replayed copy, and take one supported elite.

changes.archetype: Free attacks fuel Kunai defense, Rolling Boulder, and Body Slam
changes.summary: Prioritize cycling to establish scaling powers reliably. Free attacks grow Kunai defense; block powers Body Slam while Boulder supplies sustained damage. Remove ordinary Defends, retain the replayed copy, and avoid additional elites.

changes.archetype: Shared Maul scaling with Kunai defense and Rolling Boulder
changes.summary: Replace weak cards with four shared-scaling Mauls. Prioritize cycling and efficient defense, retain free Strikes and replayed Defend. Take three campfires and one mandatory elite; prepare resources for consecutive bosses.

changes.archetype: Maul and Boulder scaling with Kunai defense and fast cycling
changes.summary: Recovery is urgent. Keep the shop route and avoid additional fights. Prioritize potions and efficient draw over marginal cards or removals; retain free Strikes and replayed Defend. Scale Mauls behind Kunai defense.
